name: Carry in Mouth
description: One thing at a time, in the mouth. Things in the world have a mass; the carrier picks the nearest within reach, carries it along as it moves (follow(x, z)), and drops it on command, on a bark, or when another brick takes it; a thing dug back out of a den comes up held. A thing heavier than the mouth can lift is dragged instead: it comes along slower and only on the ground. While something is held the mouth is busy, so biting, eating and drinking are not available, which the carrier reports rather than enforces. Carried distance and time are counted per thing and reported each metre, for bricks that care what has been carried how far: a body that gets stronger, or a thing that is becoming something.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: things
inputs.description: Things in the world: {id, kind, mass, x, z}. mass in kilograms.

inputs.name: reach
inputs.description: How close a thing must be to be picked up, in world units.

inputs.name: maxCarryMass
inputs.description: Heaviest thing the mouth lifts; heavier is dragged.

inputs.name: dragSpeedFactor
inputs.description: Speed multiplier the carrier should apply while dragging.

outputs.name: held
outputs.description: Id of the thing in the mouth, or empty.

outputs.name: dragging
outputs.description: Whether the held thing is too heavy to lift and is being dragged.

outputs.name: speedFactor
outputs.description: 1 when free or carrying, dragSpeedFactor when dragging.

outputs.name: mouthFree
outputs.description: Whether the mouth can bite, eat or drink right now.

outputs.name: things
outputs.description: Every thing with its current position and whether it is held.

outputs.name: carried
outputs.description: Per thing id: {metres, seconds} carried so far.

outputs.name: follow
outputs.description: (x, z) -> void; the carrier moved here, so the held thing did too, and distance is counted.

outputs.name: nearest
outputs.description: (x, z) -> the thing within reach, or null.

provenance: Added 2026-11-09 for the canine survival pack (the-things-that-wake). Catalogue search first: inventory.core_inventory and inventory.slotted_bag are capacity and slots for a creature with pockets; movement.ball_carrier is one ball passed between players in a sport. None has a single mouth slot with mass that decides carry or drag, a busy mouth, and distance counted per thing. Library-native.
